mainEntity.name: How many guests can Branders sleep?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eight guests across four bedrooms. Two have sea views; two open onto an internal courtyard.

mainEntity.name: Does Branders have a private pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is heated and positioned on the ocean-facing deck. The pool is not fenced and children should be supervised.

mainEntity.name: Is there direct beach access from Branders?

acceptedAnswer.text: The house sits above a rocky tidal shelf rather than a sandy beach. Lookout Beach is a six-minute drive. Robberg Beach is fifteen minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum stay at Branders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three nights outside of December and January. Five nights during peak season.

mainEntity.name: Is Branders suitable for young children?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with supervision. The pool is unfenced and the cliff edge is unguarded. A travel cot and high chair can be arranged on request.
